title: Economic Research editions, customer returns and Workshare Installation

task.name: Operate an agreed Economic Research product and its complete receiving lifecycle
task.purpose: Give the customer a usable selected research product with original source definitions, complete captures, issued editions, explicit source-use decisions and an independently editable receiving project.
task.request: Select the actual original Workshare and Operations case. Retain the whole native economic project, exact issued Research package and any explicitly selected customer return. Review original publisher, URL, licence and acceptance metadata. Record the real source authority, purpose, redistribution and retention for each selected definition. Prepare and save the existing Customer Installation with actual host, operator, deployment, commercial and payment selections. Independently receive the complete case and all original Research files; open the saved product, every attachment and full source history. A customer return remains unadopted until the producer performs the native comparison and explicit apply operation.
task.completeOutput: The complete original Research inputs, selected source-use review, current Workshare-backed Installation, full source-draft history, whole receiving archive, independently reopened original case and editable Research project, plus actual producing-operator rendering and attachment observations.
task.repeatTrigger: An actual new source capture, product edition, customer return, scope or receiving environment creates an explicit following operation. Downloading again and retrying an interrupted request continue their original identity.
task.pricedUnit: The whole useful task recorded in the actual Workshare. Actual merchant unit price, aggregate budget, authority and payment network remain explicit selections in the original Installation.

source.reference: Exact retained native economic project bundle, issued Research package and selected optional customer return; original product, source-definition, capture, review, edition and package hashes.
source.population: Every original selected input file is retained in full. Selected issued-product requirements, source definitions, captures and ACCEPT review bindings determine the customer scope; unrelated native project history is never represented as selected product evidence.
source.meaning: Keep original publisher, URL, retrieval and saved times, HTTP status, content type, original filename and body hash. Preserve product requirement order, exact source/capture/review IDs and every authored returned definition separately from its original issued authority.
source.changePolicy: Retain all original immutable files and native versions. Reopen a saved current source selection before preparing a following Installation. A changed source or customer return does not automatically establish revised rights, accepted work, a fee or payment.

receiving.application: Original Economic Research/FRED workspace and maintained Grant Operations Customer Installation; whole-project v1–v9 receiving and native issued-package/customer-return readers.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Personally open and use the exact outgoing saved product, desktop and narrow views, all selected source downloads and complete receiving archive. Independently reopen the selected original Installation, original source draft and every received Research file. Perform explicit customer continuation through the existing native actions; preserve later receiving-side changes on repeated receipt.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: Record the customer's actual authority to use, redistribute, change and withdraw each source and output. An observed licence string or public URL does not supply missing permission. Preserve the original return and use the producer's native comparison/draft/apply sequence for adoption.
receiving.recovery: Retain the full original source files, exact upload actor/request/descriptor, native selection, preparation, source-draft history and receiving receipt. INPUT_RETAINED resumes validation without uploading again; completed request replay keeps the same input. Source repair retains original business identity. Independent receiving never overwrites later customer edits.
receiving.maintenance: Name the actual original maintainer and receiving owner. Deliver full application source and operating guides alongside exact originals. Producing peers must run/open/render the outgoing edition, VIEW actual screenshots, use important controls at desktop and narrow widths, exercise populated/empty/loading/error states and open all attachments/downloads/reopened files. Repair concrete clipped or unusable output before marking customer-ready.

steps.title: Select original commercial and source authority
steps.result: Use the existing Workshare commissioning files, exact case and explicit selected plan. Preserve authored, agreed, accepted and paid states distinctly.

steps.title: Retain every whole Research input
steps.result: Upload complete project JSON (up to480MiB), issued gzip package (256MiB) and optional customer-return gzip (256MiB) through the dedicated same-draft raw stream route; verify original bytes/SHA.

steps.title: Review the actual issued product
steps.result: Select its original producer, product and edition. Review every bound original source definition and explicitly record permitted purpose, authority, redistribution and retention.

steps.title: Prepare the original Installation
steps.result: Receive the complete Workshare seed; record actual source, host, operator, maintenance, payment and acceptance selections. Retain all source selection and preparation history.

steps.title: Attach, preview and save
steps.result: Attach exact source provenance through the original Operations source writer, then obtain a fresh original Installation preview and explicitly save it. Preparation alone does not commission or pay.

steps.title: Receive the whole customer package
steps.result: Download the complete archive containing original caseZIP, every original Research input, complete SourceDesk ledger and all outputs. Independently receive with the existing native case and Research readers.

steps.title: Continue with preserved history
steps.result: Use the customer's editable project and original return workflow. Reopen the same receiving selection without replacing later work or replaying old writes under a new identity.

steps.title: Inspect the outgoing rendered edition
steps.result: Run the exact final app and personally VIEW desktop/narrow reports and screenshots, all meaningful controls, source files, archive and downloaded/reopened working data.

inputs: Complete original Workshare commissioning source and matching optional packet, retained as original case sources.
Actual existing Operations case, current plan/version and original Installation selection.
One complete native Research project or issued package, plus optional original customer return; all bytes and hashes unchanged.
Explicit original producer/product/edition selection and a rights/use/redistribution/retention decision for each bound source definition.
Actual receiving host/operator/maintenance and original merchant/payment/authority selections; no fabricated defaults.
Original installed Node runtime and Python Grant Operations host; named independent receiving directory.
Complete whole customer archive and actual observed rendered app/attachment results.
